graszp solution architecture method

graszp (pronounced "grasp") is a lightweight solution architecture method for working with an AI assistant. A whole project lives in one markdown note, the Solution Architecture Note (SAN), with an outline distilled from TOGAF, ArchiMate, PRINCE2, Scrum, ITIL and the Microsoft Solutions Framework.

  • One note per project. Every heading stays; the size of the project sets how deep each answer goes.
  • A session loop. The AI resumes from a short note, works through the next step with the author, and hands over at the end with a new resumption note.
  • Decisions as they happen. Each decision is logged in one line, with its reason and the alternative.

The method, the session loop and the SAN template (free to use under CC BY 4.0) are at graszp.com.

Vernacular Cloud LLC develops graszp and uses it for its own projects, including this site and the Badinagean Nomenclature.
